linux-ssh.query: I'm about to SSH into the Pi and kill a stuck python process with pkill -f, then restart it under systemd. Anything I should know before I do it?
linux-ssh.why: Single-file ground truth (pkill -f self-match + systemd PATH gotchas live ONLY in linux-shell-ssh.md); entry sits mid-SPINE (#48 of 65) so position bias is not trivially in its favour; distinctive nouns (pkill, SSH, systemd) make a JEV Choice answerable from the SPINE line alone.
